scripts.start:api: cd services/api && npm install && node server.js
scripts.install:all: cd services/api && npm install && cd ../ui && npm install
scripts.version: npm --prefix services/api version $npm_package_version --no-git-tag-version && npm --prefix services/ui version $npm_package_version --no-git-tag-version && git add services/api/package*.json services/ui/package*.json
